messages:
sara: FYI PR #4387 adds a migration appendix for on-prem v0.4 -> v0.5. Need someone to sanity-check the SDK examples and a quick pass for tone. Preview available but linkcheck flagged one relative path.

ishaan: I can take SDK examples. Which language priorities?

sara: Python + TS first, then we can port to Go later. The TS snippet uses the new streaming client; verify the socket example too.

lin: I'll do voice/terminology. Heads-up: we want 'customers' -> 'users' except in legal sections. Also prefer active verbs and simple imperative for steps.

docs-bot: Docs preview built for PR #4387  linkcheck: 1 broken link (../legacy/migrations.md). Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/PR-4387/logs

ishaan: Found a mismatch in the TypeScript snippet: `client.stream()` is in the preview but the public SDK exposes `client.chat.stream()`. I'll update to chat.stream and include a note in the migration table.

sara: Good catch. Also the Python example prints `resp.text` which doesn't exist anymore, change to `resp.output_text`.

lin: Tone nits: step headings use sentence case and title case inconsistently. Recommend sentence case for step headings.

kevin: Legal requested the phrase "sensitive data" be defined once and linked. I added a short footnote in the enterprise section.

docs-bot: CI: linting passed. Linkcheck re-run failed until the relative path is removed. Rendering: code block overflow warning in mobile view for the long JS example.

sara: I'll shorten the JS example by moving the long payload into a collapsed snippet and add an inline comment summarizing fields.

ishaan: Pushed commit replacing `client.stream()` -> `client.chat.stream()` and updated TypeScript import. Also wrapped the long payload in a /*...*/ comment for the inline example.

docs-bot: Preview rebuilt for PR #4387  all checks green. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/PR-4387

lin: Quick pass done. Changed headings to sentence case and tightened a few sentences for clarity. Left two inline suggestions about replacing "will be" with "returns".

kevin: Legal OK on the footnote. No further edits.

sara: Thanks everyone. Who has merge privileges today? We need at least one technical + one docs approval per policy.

ishaan: I'm +1 on SDK changes.

lin: +1 for docs/tone.

kevin: Legal +1 (non-technical).

sara: Merging now. Will follow up with a micro changelog entry and a one-sentence notice in the migration guide index.

docs-bot: PR #4387 merged by sara at 1912601560. Changelog updated.

Note: Short Slack thread focusing on snippet standardization (chat API), link fix, mobile code rendering, tone/terminology consistency, and legal footnote.
